notes.title: VanillaBeast: Retro Knock-Out! is LIVE
notes.content:
Attention VanillaBeast fans!

You can pickup our first game in the VanillaBeast Franchise, Retro Knock-Out! on Steam NOW.

Head [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1942900/VanillaBeast_Retro_KnockOut/]HERE[/url] to checkout Retro KO! and take on over 30 parody boxers in our first game!  Retro KO! is inspired by Mike Tyson's Punch-Out! and captures the challenge of an old school retro NES game while bringing a modern and mature story to life through the visuals of Oleg Okunev's amazing art style.  Head over to the Retro KO! Steam page and get ready to take on the likes of Iron Druggo, Duster Rugless, Mason Gorehees, Sensei Grease and many others as you work your way to the reigning Champ, Tike Myson.

notes.title: 🥊Retro KO! Kickstarter Funded in 1 Hour!!!🥊
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vanillabeastgame/vanillabeast-retro-knock-out][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40172693/e21de9fee09daf468e981be440fa3fcc6361780b.png[/img][/url]

We recently launched the Retro KO! Kickstarter this week and blew goal away in 1 hour.  Now we're hunting down those stretch goals!

[b]VanillaBeast: Retro Knock-Out![/b] is the 1st prequel game to [b][i]Ace in the Hole[/i][/b].  Retro KO! kicks the "Vanillaverse" off with a Mike Tyson's Punch-Out! parody full of humor, huge bosses, and nostalgic gameplay.

Stop by the Kickstarter page ASAP to check out the rewards.  Many of the rewards are limited in number, we only have a few rewards left to create you as an actual boxer in the game!  Stop by now and get em while they're hot!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vanillabeastgame/vanillabeast-retro-knock-out]KICKSTARTER LINK[/url]

Here are a few of the awesome rewards we're offering:
[list]
[*] Get yourself (or custom character) added into the game as a ringside crowd member.
[*] Sponsor a ring and have your brand (logo, web address, product, Twitch channel, etc.) featured on a ring named and designed by YOU for the world to see during a fight.
[*] Become an opponent for the world to face!  That's right, we'll create [b]YOU[/b] (or your character) as an actual opponent for Vanilla to face in his journey to becoming the VBC Champion.  Immortalize yourself in retro gaming history with this limited supply reward.
[*] We've partnered with iiRcade and have a Kickstarter exclusive Retro KO! Arcade cabinet!  Yes, you can play Retro KO! and hundreds of other titles on this awesome arcade cabinet (comes pre-loaded with Retro KO! and 11 other games including classics Dragon's Lair and Double Dragon!).  This cabinet comes ready with WIFI capabilities that allows your to connect to your (or your neighbors) internet and download new games and play online with / against friends.  How awesome is that!
[/list]
